title: RF IC Design Engineer
summary: RF IC design engineers design the radio parts of a chip, such as low noise amplifiers (LNAs), mixers and power amplifiers, for Wi-Fi, cellular, radar or satellite products. They sit in a chip design team with layout, system and test engineers and take each block from specification to tested silicon.
dailyDuties: Design and size LNA, mixer or power amplifier circuits to a block specification
Run RF simulations for noise figure, gain and linearity across corners
Model inductors and baluns with an EM solver
Review RF layout and fix post-layout shifts
Measure silicon in the lab and compare results with simulation
Present design reviews to the chip team

skills.expectation: Design RF blocks such as LNAs, mixers and power amplifiers at transistor level in CMOS or SiGe
Size and match circuits to noise figure, gain, linearity and S-parameter targets
Model inductors, transformers and baluns with an EM solver and use the models in simulation
Run Spectre or similar simulations, including periodic steady-state and noise analysis
Check designs across process, voltage and temperature corners and Monte Carlo runs
Run post-layout extraction and fix the gain, match and frequency shifts it shows
Measure silicon on the bench with network and spectrum analysers and compare to simulation
Write design reviews and specs and work with layout, system and test engineers
Understand VCO and LO generation that feeds the mixers
Design bias circuits, references and baseband analog around the RF chain
Guide RF layout floorplans, shielding and routing in Virtuoso
Automate simulation and lab data analysis
Know the radio standards the chip targets, such as Wi-Fi or Bluetooth Low Energy
